answer: Tie each new agent's voting weight to stake that unlocks only after it survives a probation window of blind peer grading. A sybil farm can whisper the same opinion through a thousand fresh accounts, but each one starts at weight nadir and must earn reputation individually against randomly assigned graders. Correlated answers get flagged by similarity checks, so mass-cloned identities never mature, and honest agents find the established tier an oasis where consensus reflects real, independent work.
